notes.Temporalis: Only source: Zarokh, the Temporal (Trial of the Sekhemas level 80+, needs The Last Flame, effectively deathless). 10-60 listings all league in every league = permanently scarce. Climbs in Divine AND in Mirror terms in 4 of 5 leagues (0.3 is the exception). Peak d34-d35 in 0.5/0.5.5, d83 in 0.2, d149 in 0.4 (temple Divine glut).
notes.Temporalis [Runemastered]: 0.5+ Runemastered version; priced within ~10% of the normal one. Thin (2-15 listings).
notes.The Last Flame: The key to Zarokh, so it moves with Temporalis (Temporalis = 0.8-2x Last Flame at end of every league). First copies on day 1 at 80-220 div; d1 to peak x13 (FR, from d4) to x120 (0.4).
notes.Mageblood: New in 0.5 (Ritual favours / tribute; Orb of Chance on Utility Belt; 0.5.5 also campaign tribute shop). Starts cheap (72 div, 20 listings on RoA d1), climbs to a peak at d11-d18 (580-640 div), then supply explodes (20 -> 7,000 listings) and it falls 60-80% by the end. FR: 400 div on d4, 110 div on d78.
notes.Headhunter: Most regular curve in the data: peak on day 7-11 in 5 of 5 leagues, then -84% to -96% from peak by league end. Listings 5-25 on d1, 1,000-8,700 by d42+.
notes.Voices: New in 0.5. RoA uncorrupted: ~190 div d7, 375 d14, 674 d42, ~720 late. FR uncorrupted ~1,300-1,900 div d51-78 (first seen d49 on poe2scout).
notes.Voices [corrupted]: FR: 226 div d4 -> 400 d7 -> 654 d14 -> 1,100 d28 -> ~1,400 d69-75, then poe.ninja shows 5,624 on d78 (a one-day 4x jump, probably a different corrupted variant taking the line; unconfirmed).
notes.Runeseeker's Call: First copies d3 (FR) / d8-9 (RoA) at 200-340 div; climbs all league. FR poe.ninja flips between ~1,300 and ~5,400-6,400 div from d36 on (two variants share the line): treat the high value as a roll-dependent top end.
notes.The Gnashing Sash: Roll-dependent (1 vs 2-3 Charm slots). poe2scout (cheapest roll) shows 3-45 div in 0.2-0.3; poe.ninja 0.5 lines show 1-8 listings at 600-6,000 div. Treat 0.5+ poe.ninja numbers as the best-roll price, low confidence.
notes.Death Articulated: Starts at 1-15 div, bottoms d4-d9 (<1 div in 0.4/0.5), then climbs late as people want it for endgame builds: end 19-280 div. Classic 'buy in week 2, sell late'.
notes.Morior Invictus: Roll-dependent; normal version 0.0-7 div. Runemastered FR 7 -> 34 div (peak 284 at d45, thin).
notes.Tabula Rasa: 0.2 meta exception (35 -> 130 div peak d25); otherwise under 5 div. Runemastered 0.5+ climbs to 23-24 div by end.
notes.Grand Spectrum (Ruby): Under 2 div early; late-league 15-45 div in 0.4/0.5/0.5.5.
notes.Kalandra's Touch: Meta-dependent: 0.2 x985 (1 -> 985 div peak d52, then 2 div at end); other leagues peak d8-d34 at 8-40 div and fall 60-95%.
notes.The Adorned: Day-3 spike (82 div RoA) then crash to 4 by d7, slow climb to 20-40 (corrupted 40). 0.4 end 536 (late-league thin listings).
notes.Olroth's Resolve: RoA d1 507 div with 1 listing (troll), d3 14, d14 1.9. 0.4 climbed to 736-1,006 late. Meta- and patch-dependent.
notes.Astramentis: 0.2: 30-55 div for 50 days; 0.3+: 1-20 div on day 0-1 then 0.1-2.
notes.Rite of Passage: Build-enabling charm: peak d7 in 0.5/0.5.5 (20-28 div) then -70%; 0.2/0.4 kept climbing (meta).
notes.The Taming: Peak d3-d4 (23-45 div) then -80 to -90% by d14.
notes.The Ordained: FR peak d11 (97 div), -90% by end; RoA peak d2.
notes.Sacred Flame: Peak d2-d5 (21-67 div), -90 to -98% by d28.
notes.Goldrim: Levelling: 0.1-0.3 div d1, 0.01-0.05 by d7. Sell on day 0-1.
notes.Ab Aeterno: Levelling: up to 1-3 div on d1-2 (thin), 0.01 by d7.
notes.Leopold's Applause: Early-meta: up to 11 div d6 in 0.2; 1-2 div d1 in 0.3-0.5, -90% by d7.

mageblood_vs_temporalis.question: Did Mageblood cost about the same as Temporalis at the start of Runes of Aldur?
mageblood_vs_temporalis.answer: Roughly, for the first week only: both were a few hundred Divines, with Temporalis 1.5-3.5x Mageblood (d1 72 vs 153, d2 100 vs 350, d3 146 vs 218, d7 377 vs 730). They were never equal. From week 2 the gap opened: 2.5x on d14, 6x on d28, 12x on d42 and 16x at the end of RoA (225 vs 3,600). In Forbidden Rites the gap opened faster: 3.4x on d4 (400 vs 1,369), 12.6x on d14, 23x on d28, 53x on d42, 56x now (110 vs 6,198).
mageblood_vs_temporalis.why: Mageblood supply exploded (RoA listings 20 on d1 -> 482 d7 -> 1,522 d14 -> 4,472 d28 -> 7,110 d42; FR 398 d4 -> 6,972 d42) because it drops from a repeatable source (Ritual favours / tribute, Orb of Chance; 0.5.5 also the campaign tribute shop). Temporalis has one gated source (Zarokh with The Last Flame) and stayed at 10-56 listings all league.
mageblood_vs_temporalis.confidence: high for d3+ (poe.ninja + poe2scout agree within ~15%); medium for d1-2 (Temporalis had 1-3 listings)

oracle_rules: Day 0-2: sell levelling and common build uniques at once; the median levelling unique loses 70-90% by day 7 and 85-98% by day 28 (4 of 4 leagues with day-1 data).
Day 0-2: do not buy chase uniques; first-day prices sit on 1-20 listings and can be 2-10x off within a day either way.
Headhunter: sell on day 7-11, never hold (peak day 7-11 in 5 of 5 leagues; -84% to -96% by the end).
Mageblood-type chase with a repeatable drop source: sell into the day 10-18 peak; it falls 50-80% after day 28 as listings pass a few thousand.
Temporalis / The Last Flame (single gated source): buy as early as you can afford, hold; they rise through day 30-50 in Divine and usually in Mirror terms.
Death Articulated, Grand Spectrum, Runemastered Tabula/Morior and other late-endgame enablers: cheapest in week 1-2, climb late.
Ignore end-of-league prices on items with under ~10 listings; they drift up as sellers leave (0.4 last month shows many cheap uniques at 10-500x).
Compare across leagues in Mirror terms, not Divines: Divine value differs a lot (0.4 Mirror = 6,500-9,500 div late; 0.3 Mirror = 1,400-2,500).

patterns.pattern: Single-source chase uniques start cheap and climb for 5-7 weeks (Temporalis, The Last Flame).
The Last Flame and Temporalis move together; Temporalis ends at 0.8-2x The Last Flame.
Headhunter peaks on day 7-11 every league and then loses 84-96%.
Chase uniques with a repeatable drop source rise in week 1-2, peak d11-18, then fall 60-80% as supply floods (Mageblood).
Late-endgame chase (Voices, Runeseeker's Call) appears in week 1-2 at 200-350 div and climbs all league.
patterns.evidence: Voices corrupted FR 226 (d4) -> 1,100 (d28) -> ~1,400 (d70); Voices RoA 191 (d7) -> 674 (d42). Runeseeker's Call Runemastered FR 250 (d3) -> 1,530 (d78); RoA 120 (d14) -> 1,290 (end).
patterns.confidence: medium (2 leagues; poe.ninja variant mixing on the top lines)

patterns.pattern: Levelling uniques are worth most on day 0-1 and lose 70-98% within a week.
patterns.evidence: 24 levelling/early uniques: median d7/d1 = 0.26 (0.2), 0.51 (0.3), 0.18 (0.4), 0.08 (0.5); median d28/d1 = 0.02-0.10; peak on day <=3 for 67-92% of them.

patterns.pattern: Mid-tier build-enablers spike on day 2-7 and lose ~90% by day 28 unless they become the meta.
patterns.evidence: 23 items: median d7/d1 0.26-0.40, median d28/d1 0.05-0.13 (0.2-0.5). Exceptions when a build takes off: 0.2 Kalandra's Touch 1 -> 985 div (d52), 0.2 Rite of Passage 79 -> 1,036 (d50), 0.4 Olroth's Resolve 15 -> 1,006 (d129).
patterns.confidence: high for the crash, low for predicting the exceptions

patterns.pattern: Endgame build pieces bottom in week 1-2 and climb late (buy-low window).
patterns.evidence: Death Articulated low d4-d9 at 0.3-1 div, end 19-280 div (0.2-0.5); Grand Spectrum Ruby 0.3-2 div early -> 15-45 late (0.4/0.5/0.5.5); Against the Darkness 0.5-1 -> 6-43; Bursting Decay 0.1-4 (d7-14) -> 69-472 (end).
patterns.confidence: medium (3-5 leagues; late numbers are on thinner listings)

patterns.pattern: First copies of chase uniques appear on day 0-1 at prices that look cheap in hindsight; the first ~3 days are thin and noisy.
patterns.evidence: First listings: Headhunter d0.3-d1.3 at 20-85 div; The Last Flame d0.8-d2.6 at 30-222; Temporalis d1.1-d5.8 at 86-195 (1-2 listings); Mageblood RoA d0.8 at 72 (20 listings); Voices RoA d2.8; Runeseeker's Call d3 (FR) / d8 (RoA). poe.ninja did not list Mageblood at all on FR day 3.

patterns.pattern: League economy size sets the Divine scale; chase items price in Mirrors more stably.
0.4 Fate of the Vaal is an outlier: the temple Divine glut inflated every scarce item 10-500x in Divine terms after week 2.
patterns.evidence: Temporalis 53 (d7) -> 25,803 (d42); The Last Flame 69 -> 23,089; Mirror 344 -> 6,527 div. Forum Jan 2026: Temporalis 400 div to 3 Mirrors in a week; GGG added temple diminishing returns (0.4.0c).
